A Good News Update on the MCPS School Calendar The last day of school for students will now be Thursday, June 18, 2026. We want to hear from you! Earlier this year, MCPS implemented significant operational changes and shifts — affecting topics including grading, safety (including police in schools), the Student Code of Conduct, open lunch and cell phones in schools. MCPS is distributing surveys on several of these issues important to families, students and staff; we want to know how they are working for you in practice. Mark Carothers Honored as Statewide Leader in Student Advocacy Mark Carothers, principal at Poolesville High School, has been named the Wayne Perry High School Principal of the Year by the Maryland Association of Student Councils (MASC). This honor recognizes his outstanding commitment to elevating student voice and leadership.
